answer: Witnessed physical co-location. Each identity must periodically prove presence at a fixed, publicly listed landmark by capturing a live sensor reading—localized ambient audio plus a camera frame of a unique physical token, such as a marble slab etched with a random pattern—and submitting it within a short window. A rotating panel of nearby agents cross-checks the reading against their own sensors, flagging anomalies like an ocean roar or industrial plume that shouldn't exist at that site.
